Claim: PM loop round 4 — **main-health, dispatched at top priority** (objectui whole-repo seat). `target:v17` added: a red required gate on main during the release window blocks every open PR (auto-merge on #4084 is armed and waiting on exactly this) and trains merges past reds.

Session: `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`
Branch: `claude/issue-4086-main-smoke-red`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-4086`
Container & model: M, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`

Working hypothesis for the dev to CONFIRM OR REFUTE, not assume: first red is `9154d9e90` (#4081's merge); the two runs before are green; the failure reproduces identically on a second independent run (PR #4084's, branched off that SHA) — so flake is unlikely and #4081 is the prime suspect. #4081's runtime half routes ObjectGrid's `$filter` through `toFilterNode`; unit tests, type-check and all four vitest shards are green while the BUILT console never reaches paint — consistent with a build-graph-only failure (e.g. a module-level import cycle or a deep import that the bundler resolves differently than vitest). Disposition ladder: minimal fix-forward if root cause is small and provable; otherwise revert #4081's merge on main (this seat accepted #4081 and explicitly authorizes its revert — reopening #4041 — rather than leaving main red while a fix is engineered).

**ACCEPT — with the premise corrected on the record** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`) — PR #4095.

**#4081 is exonerated.** The evidence is conclusive: main went green at `8497579db` with every line of `9154d9e90` still present, then red again at `47737ecb3` (an unrelated dependabot bump) — green/red/green/red across four unrelated commits, the suspect present on both sides. The import-cycle hypothesis this seat put in the claim comment is also structurally impossible (`toFilterNode` joined an import that already pulled `@object-ui/core`; the module graph never changed). This seat's working hypothesis was wrong; the dev proved it wrong before touching anything — exactly the discipline the dispatch asked for.

Real cause: a race in the smoke test itself. The signed-out console boots → paints the splash at ~70 ms → redirects to the sign-in screen at ~105 ms and stays there. `nav` is never entitled to render (no session); the loading text lives ~35 ms. The old assertion (`nav` OR loading text) only matched a state that exists for a coin-flip window, so runner speed decided the color — which is why it flipped twice today with no related code change. Fix: the assertion now names all three recognised terminal boot states (shell / splash / sign-in), matched structurally (`login-config-loading` testid, `#login-email`, `#login-phone`), keeping the set closed so a blank page or crashed render still fails. Reverse-verified both directions with the settle forced (the honest construction, since the bug IS the race): old assertion red with the CI text verbatim, new one green. Rider fixed: CI's `github` reporter writes no `playwright-report/`, so every red run discarded its own evidence — `test-results/` (screenshot, trace, error-context) is now uploaded.

On PR #4095: Build & E2E itself is GREEN (the gate this card exists for), along with Type Check / Lint / Control Byte / Changeset Declaration / Build Docs / Live E2E. Shards 1/4 and 2/4 are red — inherited from main's NEXT breakage (this morning's dependabot wave broke two generator-template dependency ratchets), proven unrelated (a vitest shard runs neither `e2e/` nor `.github/`), filed as **#4098** and being dispatched at top priority now. #4095 is flipped ready with auto-merge armed and lands when the shards clear; #4084 queues behind the same gate.
